_meta.purpose: Machine-readable critical EMS UI flow inventory for the final browser-smoke/accessibility/readiness gate. Route/permission data is derived from src/lib/ems/navigation/registry.ts (EMS_MODULES) and src/lib/rbac/role-templates.ts (SYSTEM_ROLE_TEMPLATES) — those two files remain the single source of truth; this file records which critical flows they compose into and how each was verified, not a second copy of the route list.
_meta.seedScript: prisma/seed/ems-demo.ts (pnpm run db:seed:ems-demo) — synthetic data only, never real environmental figures

checkTypes.routeDiscovery: Route resolves for an authorised persona and is linked from /ems or its own module list, per EMS_MODULES.
checkTypes.notBlank: Page renders a real heading/content for an authorised persona with synthetic data, not an empty body or error boundary.
checkTypes.emptyState: A zero-row list renders an explicit 'no records' message rather than a blank container.
checkTypes.a11yAutomated: axe-core scan (wcag2a/wcag2aa/wcag22aa) has zero critical/serious violations.
checkTypes.keyboard: Critical-flow nav/controls are reachable by Tab and show a visible focus indicator.
checkTypes.responsive: No horizontal overflow at a 375px mobile viewport; nav 'More' menu remains usable.
checkTypes.rbacBoundary: A persona without a module's permission gets redirected on direct URL access, never a 500 or blank render.
checkTypes.tenantScope: RESTRICTED-access-mode persona only sees data scoped to its own Entity/Site.

criticalFlows.description: EMS dashboard/home — leadership overview, status/overdue counts, report/export entry points.
Programme status, scope boundary, context, interested parties, planned changes.
Controlled documents register and evidence hub, including SharePoint connection status where configured.
Personal work queue: due/overdue reminders and delivery status.
Aspect register -> significance assessment -> operational control linkage, plus monitoring, providers, communications, emergency preparedness.
Legal candidate -> applicability -> obligation approval -> compliance evaluation chain.
criticalFlows.notes: /ems/legal/provider-health requires ems.legal_source.manage — Sustainability Lead only among seeded personas; used as the primary rbacBoundary probe for contributor/readOnly/restrictedSite.

criticalFlows.description: Objective/metric definition -> progress -> linked action programmes.
Audit programme/execution -> finding -> nonconformity -> root cause -> corrective action -> effectiveness review chain.
criticalFlows.notes: Previously the audits module (audit-forms.tsx, audit-detail-forms.tsx) had no empty-state message for zero programmes/audits/findings — fixed in this task.

criticalFlows.description: Competence requirements/people/assignments -> evidence submission/verification -> expiry tracking. Explicitly the pair (with management-review pack/minutes) that previously blocked T82.
criticalFlows.notes: Seeded with one active assignment + verified evidence and one assignment/evidence pair expiring within 30 days, per prisma/seed/ems-demo.ts.

criticalFlows.description: Review cycle/agenda -> deterministic pack generation/issue -> minutes -> decisions -> action links -> closure. The other flow that previously blocked T82.
criticalFlows.notes: Seeded with one held/complete review with an issued pack, approved minutes, and one decision, per prisma/seed/ems-demo.ts.

criticalFlows.description: Reporting/export entry points reachable from the EMS dashboard.
Cross-cutting: denied-module direct access, suspended membership, and restricted-access-mode scoping — not a single module, exercised across the registry.
